1.en_consolidated_definition:
To be difficult.

Alternatively:

Be troublesome.
Be problematic.
Pose a challenge.
Be hard to deal with or manage.

Or more specifically in some contexts:

Be recalcitrant (referring to someone who is stubbornly resistant to control or authority).
Be obstinate (referring to someone who is persistently refusing to change their opinion or course of action).

Note: Las traducciones anteriores pueden variar dependiendo del contexto en el que se utilice la palabra "difícil" en español.
